title: Austin Modernizes Power Plant Fuel Use
summary:
*   City leaders approved a significant upgrade: purchasing a new mechanical stoker system for Austin's water tube boiler.
*   The core goal was to improve the efficiency of burning coal and lignite, an early focus on resource optimization for the city's power plant.
*   The contract included expert services for professional installation supervision and specialized training for city firemen on best fuel-burning practices.
*   The $5,170 cost was payable in installments, with part of the payment contingent on the system's successful operation after a trial period.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
AUSTIN, TEXAS, January 22, 1923.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor, Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and Searight, 5; absent, none.
Councilman Haynes moved that Councilman Eyres be authorized to contract with

prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; nayes, none.
